facts.fact: 两人相识于单车课：他一出场全场目光都在他身上；她起初只当他「很 vanilla」。
facts.anchor: The eyeballs of almost everyone in that spin class bulged at the sight of his toned torso, threatening to tear through the fabric of his navy-blue sports top.

facts.fact: 他让她感到「被理解」，她陷了进去，如今爱得发狂。
facts.anchor: But it’s not just chemistry, he makes me feel understood, in a way I never thought falling for the nice guy ever could.

facts.fact: 厨房门后母子争吵，George 压低声说：「现在不一样了……我知道自己在干什么。」
facts.anchor: ‘It’s different now…I know what I’m doing.’

facts.fact: 她摔进厨房，他第一时间死死攥住她的手腕，攥得她的手都发白了。
facts.anchor: The second is that his fingers are now wrapped around my wrist so tightly that my hand is turning pale.

facts.fact: Maria 恶意叫错她的名字，喊她「Becky」。
facts.anchor: ‘Take your seat, Becky. I’ll grab an extra plate and cutlery, shall I, George?’

facts.fact: 上菜次序：儿子第一、Maria 自己第二、她最后；而且肉汁已经浇满了她的整盘。
facts.anchor: Like the fact she’s already poured gravy over my entire plate.

facts.fact: 她问肉汁是不是无麸质，Maria 恶毒回击——她明明早知道 Blair 麸质不耐（George 预先告知过）。
facts.anchor: ‘Absolutely not.’ She practically spits with venom. ‘Why on earth would it be?’

facts.fact: George 不站在她这边：吃一点没事、伤不了身材、别当苦情剧女主。
facts.anchor: ‘Blair can just eat a wee bit of it. Won’t do her figure any harm. She’s just being a bit of a drama queen, but she’ll be fine.’
